item.title: Lauryn Hill & Wyclef Jean, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, Lenny Kravitz & Lainey Wilson to Headline 2026 Global Citizen Festival
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast! Today, we're talking about the upcoming 2026 Global Citizen Festival in New York's Central Park. Get ready for an exciting lineup of performers and a great cause. Let's dive in!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "This year's festival will feature K-pop superstars TOMORROW X TOGETHER, reunited Fugees bandmates Lauryn Hill and Wyclef Jean, Lenny Kravitz, John Legend, Shaboozey, and Lainey Wilson. The event will be hosted by Hugh Jackman, with appearances by Rachel Brosnahan and Gayle King, and more names to be announced soon."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The festival is part of the world's largest movement to end extreme poverty. This year, it will focus on three core issues: creating opportunities for children's education, supporting smallholder farmers, and providing access to electricity. The event will take place on September 26th on the Great Lawn in Central Park."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Tickets to the festival are free and can be earned by taking action on the Global Citizen app or at globalcitizenfestival.com. You can also make a $25 charitable donation to instantly secure your ticket. As Lainey Wilson said, 'It's a chance to come together and support important work... and have a whole lot of fun while we're at it.'"
[Short music transition]
Host: "The festival aims to create opportunities for two million children to go to school, support 1.5 million smallholder farmers, and provide electricity for 2.5 million homes. All donations will also give back to New York City, supporting youth education programming and parks initiatives across all five boroughs."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "So, mark your calendars for September 26th and join the movement to end extreme poverty. As Hugh Jackman said, 'There's something every one of us can do to change the world.' Get your tickets and be a part of this amazing event. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll see you at the Global Citizen Festival!"
